diagnostic_steps: Check DTC in control unit 0013 with exact symptom 196672 and current state.
Record J428 old SW part 2Q0907567B (0534) or 2Q0907567C (0541) before considering applicability.

After update verify radar/ACC readiness and residual codes; do not replace module solely on this bulletin condition.
